metadata.title: Pork  With  Dry Bamboo  Shoots | Naga Style
metadata.description:
Hot and Tangy Naga pork dish with dried bamboo shoots is a mouth-watering dish made out of fresh pork. 

This classic succulent pork dish goes really well with steamed rice a staple of the northeastern tribes and commonly features in platter of the Naga people.
